title: Attention Is All You Need
text: We introduce the Transformer architecture. For background, see https://example.com/beta. Our work extends prior studies. See also 10.5678/beta_study and arxiv:2101.00001.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
text: Building on the Transformer architecture (Vaswani, 2017). We also cite 10.1234/alpha for context. See https://example.com/alpha for more. We reference arxiv:2101.00001 as well.

title: GPT: Generative Pre-trained Transformer
text: Following the Transformer (Vaswani, 2017) and BERT work. We also reference 10.1234/alpha. See arxiv:2101.00001.

title: A Survey of Language Models
text: This survey covers attention mechanisms and pre-training. See 10.1234/alpha and 10.5678/beta_study. Also arxiv:2101.00001 and arxiv:2201.00002.
